record.one_liner: FX audit layer that compares the rate a bank or card applied against the mid-market rate and quantifies hidden FX spreads.
record.auth_notes: critic: api_key confirmed via vendor-org GitHub README: hosted MCP uses a Bearer API key from ipayx.ai/ai-access; some tools need no auth (3 free audits per IP per month). No OAuth documented. ipayx.ai/docs and /ai-access render only a landing page.
record.access_notes: critic: kept self_serve_free, now backed by vendor-owned README: 'get a free key at ipayx.ai'. Some tools work with no auth.
record.api_notes: critic: no documented REST/GraphQL HTTP API found on any vendor page; the product is exposed as an MCP server (hosted mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp and npm @ipayx/mcp-fx-audit). api_style stays none.
record.blocker_notes: critic: mcp community -> official (vendor GitHub org iPAYX-Technologies hosts mcp-fx-audit and a vendor-domain remote MCP URL). Verdict stays blocked: no documented public HTTP API, only MCP access; vendor docs pages are a bare landing page.
